project: 推し活スラング × 無感情な工業用オブジェクト
target: 推し活・現場通い界隈（全通／実質無料などのスラングを日常使用する熱狂的ファン層）
art_direction: 無感情な工業用オブジェクト（ボルト・歯車など）の3DCG風
layout_rule: テキストは必ず上側。イラストは下側。生成時は上部35%を空白として確保する。

stamps.concept_ja: 大きな六角ボルトが1本、無機質に直立
stamps.subject_en: one single oversized hexagonal steel bolt standing perfectly upright and motionless, dead straight, absolutely still

stamps.concept_ja: 連結されたチェーンが画面奥から手前へ続く
stamps.subject_en: a heavy steel roller chain of identical connected links running from deep in the background straight toward the viewer, endless repetition, strong one point perspective

stamps.concept_ja: パイプから大量の潤滑油が溢れ、水没しかける歯車
stamps.subject_en: thick amber lubricant oil gushing out of a burst pipe and flooding a steel gear that is almost fully submerged, viscous overflowing liquid

stamps.concept_ja: 赤く錆びついてポツンと転がるワッシャー
stamps.subject_en: a single small heavily red rusted washer lying abandoned and alone on a bare concrete floor, forgotten, tiny in a wide empty space

stamps.concept_ja: プレス機がゆっくり下がりプレスする直前
stamps.subject_en: the ram of a massive hydraulic press descending slowly, frozen one instant before it crushes the workpiece below, immense mechanical pressure

stamps.concept_ja: ノギスがピカピカのベアリング球の直径を測る
stamps.subject_en: a stainless steel vernier caliper precisely measuring the diameter of a flawless mirror polished ball bearing, chrome reflections

stamps.concept_ja: 巨大なモーターが力強く回転
stamps.subject_en: a huge industrial electric motor spinning at full power, rotational motion blur on the shaft, overwhelming torque

stamps.concept_ja: 祭壇のように積まれたナットの中央に輝く金色のボルト
stamps.subject_en: steel hex nuts stacked into an altar like pedestal with one radiant golden bolt enshrined at the center, holy backlight and god rays

stamps.concept_ja: 金属疲労で真っ二つに割れる寸前のスプリング
stamps.subject_en: a coil spring stretched far past its limit, metal fatigue cracks spreading across it, one instant before it snaps in two

stamps.jp_text: 現場（ここ）が世界の中心
stamps.concept_ja: 複雑なアセンブリ図面のど真ん中を指す赤い矢印
stamps.subject_en: a bold red arrow pointing at the exact dead center of a complex mechanical assembly blueprint, flat top down view of the drawing

stamps.concept_ja: 規則正しく並んだ分厚い鋼鉄のブロック
stamps.subject_en: thick heavy rectangular steel gauge blocks lined up in a perfectly regular row, identical spacing, immovable and unchanging

stamps.jp_text: チケ発（戦）行ってきます
stamps.concept_ja: カチッとスイッチが入った瞬間のトグルスイッチ
stamps.subject_en: an industrial metal toggle switch caught at the exact instant it clicks into the ON position, small indicator light igniting

stamps.concept_ja: ワッシャーを高く積み上げていくアームロボット
stamps.subject_en: a robotic arm patiently stacking flat washers into a tall precarious tower, one washer held in the gripper

stamps.concept_ja: 深いネジ穴へ真っ逆さまに落ちる一本のネジ
stamps.subject_en: a single machine screw falling headfirst into a deep dark threaded bore hole, plunging straight down, bottomless darkness below

stamps.concept_ja: クレーンで吊るされた鉄骨が下のボルトを見下ろす
stamps.subject_en: a massive steel H beam suspended from a crane hook looming high above one small bolt on the floor, extreme scale difference, low angle

stamps.concept_ja: センサーの赤いレーザーがリベットを捕捉
stamps.subject_en: a red laser line from an industrial sensor locking precisely onto a single rivet, glowing scan beam in slight haze

stamps.concept_ja: 2つの歯車が完全に噛み合い激しく火花が散る
stamps.subject_en: two steel gears meshing together in perfect engagement, violent orange sparks bursting from the contact point

stamps.concept_ja: コンベアの脇に転がる不良品のピン
stamps.subject_en: one rejected defective dowel pin fallen off to the side of a running conveyor belt, left behind out of the line

stamps.concept_ja: 鏡面仕上げの美しい丸いディスクが光を反射
stamps.subject_en: a beautiful perfectly round mirror finished metal disc catching and reflecting a sharp band of light, flawless surface

stamps.concept_ja: フォークリフトが同じ部品のパレットを山積み
stamps.subject_en: a forklift stacking pallets loaded with identical parts higher and higher, towering repetitive cargo stack

stamps.concept_ja: 同じCAD図面がプリンターから何枚も吐き出される
stamps.subject_en: identical technical CAD drawings pouring out of a large format printer one after another, sheets piling up

stamps.concept_ja: 冷却水が沸騰しボコボコ泡立つタンク
stamps.subject_en: coolant boiling violently in an open steel tank, big bubbles bursting, steam rising hard

stamps.concept_ja: 頑丈なロック機構がガチャリと開く瞬間
stamps.subject_en: a heavy duty steel lock mechanism at the exact moment the bolt retracts and unlatches, shackle popping open

stamps.concept_ja: エアダスターで勢いよく吹き飛ばされる木ねじ
stamps.subject_en: a wood screw blasted violently sideways out of frame by a jet of compressed air from an air duster nozzle, motion streak

stamps.concept_ja: クレーンゲームのアームのような機械が赤いボルトを掴む
stamps.subject_en: a claw machine style robotic gripper clamping down on one bright red bolt among plain silver bolts, the moment of the catch

stamps.concept_ja: 開いたままの空のジュラルミンケース
stamps.subject_en: an empty aluminum duralumin flight case left wide open with hollow gray foam inserts inside, nothing in it, waiting

stamps.concept_ja: 2つの異なるギアが赤い回転矢印で入れ替わる図解
stamps.subject_en: two different gears swapping places connected by a red circular exchange arrow, clean instructional diagram style

stamps.concept_ja: 太い結束バンドでまとめられた複数のボルトとナット
stamps.subject_en: an assorted bundle of bolts and nuts strapped tightly together by one thick black cable tie, forced into a single lot

stamps.concept_ja: 公差や寸法がびっしり書き込まれた複雑なCAD図面
stamps.subject_en: an extremely dense technical CAD drawing packed edge to edge with dimension lines, tolerance callouts and section views, flat top down view

stamps.concept_ja: コンベアの上で等間隔に並び運ばれる無数のナット
stamps.subject_en: countless identical hex nuts carried along a conveyor belt at perfectly equal intervals, a long orderly queue receding into the distance

stamps.concept_ja: パンチングメタルに無数の小さなネジが打ち込まれている
stamps.subject_en: a perforated metal panel densely studded with countless tiny screws driven into every hole, obsessively filled surface

stamps.concept_ja: 暗闇のレール上を淡々と進む無人の搬送用台車
stamps.subject_en: an unmanned automated transport cart rolling quietly along a rail through pitch darkness, one lonely small headlamp, night

stamps.concept_ja: 仕切られたパーツボックスの空きスペース
stamps.subject_en: a compartmentalized parts organizer box seen from above, every cell filled with parts except one conspicuously empty slot

stamps.concept_ja: 「合格」の緑色スタンプが押された金属板
stamps.subject_en: a brushed metal inspection plate marked with a large green circular approval stamp containing a bold check mark symbol, no lettering

stamps.concept_ja: バグを起こして文字化けした機械の液晶ディスプレイ
stamps.subject_en: an industrial machine LCD panel glitching out, the display broken into scrambled colored glitch blocks and corrupted pixel noise, unreadable garbage, no legible characters

stamps.concept_ja: 万力でギリギリと締め上げられる鉄パイプ
stamps.subject_en: a steel pipe clamped in a heavy bench vise and being crushed, the wall visibly deforming and buckling under pressure

stamps.concept_ja: メーターの針が限界を振り切れ激しくブレる圧力計
stamps.subject_en: an analog pressure gauge with the needle slammed hard past the red danger limit and vibrating wildly, needle motion blur, cracked glass

stamps.concept_ja: 金色に輝く超硬合金のエンドミルが後光を放つ
stamps.subject_en: a gold titanium nitride coated carbide end mill standing vertically and radiating a divine halo of light, god rays, sacred glow

stamps.concept_ja: 完全にショートして黒焦げになったヒューズ
stamps.subject_en: a completely blown fuse, glass blackened with soot and the filament burnt through, a thin wisp of smoke still rising, total failure

stamps.jp_text: 今日も推しが生きていることに感謝
stamps.concept_ja: 高い天井の水銀灯が静かに無人の現場を照らす
stamps.subject_en: a mercury vapor lamp high on a factory ceiling quietly illuminating a vast deserted plant floor at night, silent empty wide space, single pool of light
